notes: Backtests use local Freqtrade futures OHLCV data.
Funding rate and mark price histories are converted to Freqtrade futures format through 2026-05-31; June 2026 static aux archives are not available yet.
The agent must not promote any strategy directly to live trading.

strategies.name: BtcEthFuturesRegime10xOneMinuteStrategy
strategies.hypothesis: 24h/72h/7d BTC/ETH regime signal at 10x may reduce high-leverage noise while preserving directional edge.
strategies.risk_notes: Full-sample return was small and below market change in prior manual tests.

strategies.name: BtcEthFuturesRegime10xPullbackShortOnlyStrategy
strategies.hypothesis: Short-only pullback/resume entries in a slow bearish regime may be cleaner than bidirectional futures entries.
strategies.risk_notes: Low drawdown but weak absolute return; still requires slippage stress, out-of-sample checks, and dry-run validation.

strategies.name: BtcEthFuturesEthSelfPullbackShortOnlyStrategy
strategies.hypothesis: ETH's own bearish regime plus pullback/resume confirmation may work better than BTC hard-filtered ETH entries.
strategies.risk_notes: Only trades ETH; currently a research candidate, not a dry-run default.

strategies.name: BtcEthFuturesBtcLead60mEthPullbackShortStrategy
strategies.hypothesis: BTC slow bearish regime delayed by 60 minutes may filter ETH pullback shorts.
strategies.risk_notes: Prior manual test was poor; retained as a negative-control strategy.
